column1: # Wallbox BLE Gateway - OTA-capable partition table
# Two app partitions for OTA swap
# coredump (#168): Arduino's precompiled IDF libs already ship with
# CONFIG_ESP_COREDUMP_ENABLE_TO_FLASH + DATA_FORMAT_ELF
# handler has always been ready to write a full ELF core — it just had
# nowhere to put it. This partition is that somewhere. Without it every
# watchdog/panic reboot throws its backtrace away and we're left guessing.
# The 128K comes out of the app partitions (0x1F0000 -> 0x1E0000 each
# still ~525K of headroom over the current 1.44M image). nvs (0x9000) and
# nvs2 (0x3F0000) keep their EXACT offsets so settings and the charge log
# survive the re-flash — do not move them.
# NOTE: a partition-table change cannot be applied over OTA. Existing
# installs keep their old table (and simply get no coredumps) until a USB
# re-flash; new USB installs get it from the start. See docs/INSTALL.md.
